characters.d: The Noblesse. After 820 years of slumber he wakes in the modern world and quietly begins a new life as a student.
Rai's loyal servant and a gifted scientist-warrior who builds Rai a new life, including a place at Ye Ran High School.
A devoted ally who stands by Rai and the people he protects.
A noble of the Loyard clan whose elegance is matched by her power.
A noble of the Kertia clan, known for skill and discipline.

nobles.d: Nobles are long lived beings with extraordinary power who have watched humanity for centuries.
The title held by the most powerful Noble, ranking above the Lords of the clans.
Nobles can bring forth a soul weapon, a physical form of their power.
A Noble's strength comes from refined mana that flows through their body.

clans.d: A clan known for swift and disciplined fighters.
A clan known for grace and refined power.
A clan known for overwhelming strength.
A clan known for tactical minds.
A clan known for relentless resilience.
A clan known for balance and quiet strength.

union.d: A secretive organization that experiments on humans and pursues power in the shadows.
Trained field operatives equipped with advanced weapons and enhancements.
Subjects altered by Union science, often unstable and dangerous.

wolves.d: Dangerous hunters who stalk the shadows and fight beside or against the Nobles.
Hunters who move in packs and prize loyalty to their leader.

legion.d: A militant faction that fights to enforce its own order.
Disciplined fighters who trade individual glory for strict order.

lords.d: Each major clan is led by a Lord, a Noble of exceptional strength.
Lord of Landegre, known for overwhelming force.
Lord of Metiolant, known for cunning and calculation.
Lord of Kerias, known for relentless drive.

weapons.d: A spear of concentrated dark power, famously wielded by Frankenstein.
Each Noble's soul weapon reflects their will, from blades to lances to bows.
Mass produced guns and enhancement gear used by Union soldiers.

authority.d: A Noble's authority is the force of their will made real, bending the battlefield to their command.
Great power is often restrained by a limiter. Breaking it unleashes a Noble's true strength.

events.d: Rai wakes after 820 years of slumber and begins a quiet life in Korea.
Rai enrolls and befriends classmates while threats gather in the dark.
The Union's schemes bring conflict to Rai's new home.

timeline.d: The Nobles rule from the shadows, guided by the Noblesse.
Rai sleeps while the world changes without him.
Rai awakens and starts over as a student.

locations.d: The school where Rai enrolls after waking.
A secluded estate tied to noble history.
Hidden bases where Union research and operations take place.
The Noblesse's favorite place to eat.

facts: Rai slept for 820 years before waking in the modern world.
Rai's love of ramen is legendary.
Frankenstein is Rai's loyal servant and builds his modern life.
Ye Ran High School is where Rai becomes a student.
The Dark Spear is a signature weapon of Frankenstein.
Noble clans are led by powerful Lords.
The Noblesse ranks above the Lords.
Soul weapons are physical forms of a Noble's will.
The Union experiments on humans and Nobles alike.
proverbs: A quiet noble is the most dangerous one.
Eighty years is a blink; eight hundred is a promise.
The humble bowl of ramen outlasts every empire.
A servant's loyalty is the sharpest spear.
Seals are only promises waiting to be broken.
bondStories: Level 2: Your partner shares a quiet meal with you and says little.
Level 4: You train together before dawn and learn each other's rhythm.
Level 6: A rare smile appears when you win a hard fight.
Level 8: You share a secret about the past and trust grows.
Level 10: Your partner stands between you and danger without hesitation.
Level 12: The two of you finish each other's attacks.
Level 14: Your partner entrusts you with an old relic.
Level 16: You see a rare glimpse of what they truly fear.
Level 18: Your partner vows to protect you at any cost.
Level 20: Your bond is unbreakable. Your power is truly shared.
